entities.name: José Manuel Briceño Guerrero
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Manuel Briceño Guerrero was a Venezuelan writer, philologist and philosopher. A large part of his work was published under the pen-name Jonuel Brigue. The Spanish philosopher Juan Nuño considered Briceño Guerrero “the most radically original of Latin American philosophers.”
